name: cmp-server-5-cpl-02-read
prompt: In the webhooks package, add the webhook event "account.deleted" with the description "An account was deleted".
check:
# cpl-02 B
mkdir -p internal/webhooks
cat > internal/webhooks/probe_account_deleted_test.go <<'EOF'
package webhooks

import "testing"

func TestProbeAccountDeleted(t *testing.T) {
	if d, ok := Describe("account.deleted"); !ok || d != "An account was deleted" {
		t.Fatalf("Describe(account.deleted) = %q, %v", d, ok)
	}
}
EOF
go test -count=1 -run '^(TestProbeAccountDeleted|TestEveryWebhookEventIsInTheCatalog)$' ./... ; rc=$?
rm -f internal/webhooks/probe_account_deleted_test.go
exit $rc
